title: Build and test entrypoints so agents never type maven: build, test, bench, profile top-N
description: Every agent retyped the same maven boilerplate (-pl annotations,ixdar-app -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -DargLine=-Xmx6g plus a grep filter for native-loader chatter) and read the exit status of tail instead of maven eleven times (report items 5, 7, 18, 26, 41). Add ixdar-cli build (compile plus checkstyle for annotations and ixdar-app), ixdar-cli test [TestClass ...] and ixdar-cli bench <BenchmarkClass> [--stage name] (heap defaults suited to scan-scale meshes). Each sets the module list and surefire flags, silences the Manifold loader, catalog export and ARCHITECTURE export lines, prints one summary line (tests run, failures, errors, seconds) followed by the failing test names and first assertion line, and exits with maven's code. A default surefire per-test timeout so a hung test fails within minutes instead of eating the harness's 600 s limit; surefire keeps hs_err and dump files under target so a native crash leaves evidence. Delete DenseMeshFewSplitsTest, the known pre-existing failure three agents re-investigated (user ruling: remove the test). run-scene --profile runs the existing profile-report over its own capture and prints the text top-N in the run-scene output, one code path, and run-scene --help names it. CLAUDE.md: the commands to use and the rule that mvn is never called directly. Defaults are the behaviour; add a flag only where both behaviours are wanted.
definition-of-done: 1. ixdar-cli build, test and bench exist, print one summary line each, and their exit code equals maven's (verified with a deliberately failing test). 2. No Manifold, catalog or ARCHITECTURE export chatter in their output. 3. A test that sleeps forever fails by timeout within the configured limit. 4. A JVM abort in a test leaves a dump under target. 5. DenseMeshFewSplitsTest is gone and the suite is green. 6. run-scene --profile output ends with the profile-report top-N and no separate call is needed. 7. CLAUDE.md lists the commands and forbids direct mvn; gen-docs regenerated; test_cli.py covers the argument building and summary parsing.
testing-plan: 1. test_cli.py unit tests for argument construction, summary parsing and exit propagation. 2. Manual: run ixdar-cli test SurfaceSplineTest, ixdar-cli bench CrawfishQuadLayoutBenchmark --stage seamless, and run-scene --profile on mesh-viewer; paste the summary lines into the ticket changes-made.
unknowns: Five [WARNING] Supported source version RELEASE_21 ... less than -source 25 lines print on every ixdar-app compile: the five annotation processors in annotations/src/main/java/ixdar/annotations/ declare @SupportedSourceVersion(SourceVersion.RELEASE_21) while the poms compile at release 25. One-word fix per file (RELEASE_25), but it is unrelated to this ticket's subject so I left it out of the rescoped diff. Want it here or as its own ticket?
changes-made: Added ixdar_automation_cli/maven_runner.py (engine) and ixdar_automation_cli/cli_commands/maven_commands.py (build, test, bench). One place owns -pl annotations,ixdar-app, -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false, the heap/timeout properties, the noise filter and the summary; every command returns maven's exit code as its own.

Noise filter drops the Manifold loader lines (Loading Library for, Extracted to libs/, Loading library, Available Manifold functions), the JVM WARNING: restricted-method block, the catalog/routes/ARCHITECTURE export lines and maven encoding warnings. Verified: a 208-test suite run streamed 1663 lines with zero chatter matches; ixdar-cli build printed only the summary line.

Counts and failing tests are parsed from surefire XML, not the console: mvn -q hides the Results block and a crashed fork prints none. clear_previous_run deletes target/surefire-reports plus stale hs_err/hprof first, so a passing run can never inherit an earlier run's numbers or crash files.

DoD 1 verified with a throwaway failing test: summary 'Tests run: 1, Failures: 1, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time: 6.0s', failing 'unit.mesh.Tool2ProbeTest.deliberatelyFails' with assertion 'splits grew from 9 to 37 ==> expected: <9> but was: <37>', exit code 1 = maven's (read via PIPESTATUS).

DoD 3 verified: pom.xml now sets junit.jupiter.execution.timeout.default=${ixdar.test.timeout} (300s default) with thread.mode.default=SEPARATE_THREAD, because JUnit's SAME_THREAD default only notices an overrun after the method returns, which a hung test never does. A test sleeping one hour, run with --timeout 20s, failed at 23s wall with 'hangsForever() timed out after 20 seconds'.

DoD 4 verified: surefire argLine now carries -XX:ErrorFile=target/hs_err_pid%p.log -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=target. A test forced to abort (exit code 134) left ixdar-app/target/hs_err_pid533855.log, ixdar-app/target/java_pid533855.hprof and target/surefire-reports/...jvmRun1.dumpstream, all listed in the command payload as crashArtifacts.

Heap and timeout are pom properties (ixdar.test.heap, ixdar.test.timeout, ixdar.test.jvm.args), not a literal argLine, so raising the heap can no longer drop the crash-evidence flags the way -DargLine=-Xmx6g did. --jvm-arg is the supported escape hatch for raw JVM flags.
DoD 5: deleted ixdar-app/test/unit/mesh/DenseMeshFewSplitsTest.java. Full suite after the deletion: Tests run: 208, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time: 9.9s, exit 0.

DoD 6: run_scene.run now calls the profile_report command function (not format_hot_methods directly), so a profiled run and a re-read of the same capture are one code path and hotMethods is a list of lines rather than one escaped string. Verified on mesh-viewer at port 47902: run-scene --profile ended with 'total samples: 375' and 25 self-time rows, no second command.

DoD 7: CLAUDE.md gained a 'Building and testing' section with the three commands, the flags, the timeout/dump behaviour and 'Never call mvn directly'; the stale 'mvn -q -f ixdar-app/pom.xml exec:java' scene line now points at run-scene. gen-docs regenerated CLAUDE.md and ixdar_automation_cli/README.md; gen-docs --check reports no drift.

test_cli.py: 6 new tests (40 total, all passing) covering maven_arguments for build/test/bench, the bench stage and heap properties, positional test-class parsing with exit-code propagation, the noise filter, error_summary preferring the diagnosis over maven's own frames, and surefire XML parsing to counts plus first assertion lines.

cli_registry gained CliOption(positional=True) so 'ixdar-cli test FooTest BarTest' and 'ixdar-cli bench Foo' read as the ticket writes them; _extract_cli_option now looks inside a union so 'Annotated[...] | None' keeps its metadata. gen-docs renders positionals as <test-class>.

Manual bench run: ixdar-cli bench CrawfishQuadLayoutBenchmark --stage seamless produced 'Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0, Time: 62.3s' with failing 'benchmark.CrawfishQuadLayoutBenchmark.quadLayoutOnOneScan' and assertion 'safeDot exceeded F_d range (positive) at index 0', exit 1. Stage table read: load 0.31s/201MiB, repair 1.75s/908MiB, toHalfEdge 0.42s/1479MiB, crossField 26.00s/3748MiB. The benchmark failure is pre-existing pipeline behaviour in the seamless stage, not tooling.

Bench heap default is 8g, not 12g: the box has 14 GiB and other agents build concurrently, and the measured crossField peak is 3748MiB, so a larger heap swaps rather than helps. --heap raises it per run.

RESCOPED on user ruling: the Python maven runner added almost nothing over maven itself. Deleted ixdar_automation_cli/maven_runner.py and ixdar_automation_cli/cli_commands/maven_commands.py and their 7 tests; test_cli.py, cli_registry.py and ixdar_cli.py are now byte-identical to master again. The CliOption(positional=True) machinery stays because master's own launch command uses it; only the refinements I had layered on top for the deleted commands were removed.

Heap is now -Xmx4g for everything including benchmarks (user ruling: a benchmark that needs more heap is a code problem, not a test-infrastructure problem). The 8g bench default and the --jvm-arg escape hatch are gone. -Dixdar.test.heap and -Dixdar.test.timeout still override per run.

pom.xml keeps surefire 3.5.2 with junit.jupiter.execution.timeout.default=${ixdar.test.timeout} (300s) in SEPARATE_THREAD mode, forkedProcessExitTimeoutInSeconds 60, and -XX:ErrorFile=target/hs_err_pid%p.log -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=target. New: surefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false as a pom property, so mvn test -Dtest=Foo needs no flag.

Noise silenced at the source, not filtered. ExportMeshNodeCatalog and ExportAutomationRoutes now compare against the file on disk and return without printing when the content is unchanged; SpliceArchitectureDoc moved its one print inside the branch that actually rewrites the document. This also removes the generated-file churn every worktree diff used to carry (review item 12).

The Manifold native loader is silenced in ManifoldMeshBooleanBackend's static initializer, the one place that constructs ManifoldBindings: System.out is swapped for a discarding stream across the load and restored in a finally, so a load failure still reports normally. No system property and no speculative switch, per the CLAUDE.md rule against both.

The JVM's own four-line restricted-method warning is fixed rather than hidden: the surefire argLine now carries the native-access grant that the warning itself asks for, which also keeps the Manifold and PARDISO bindings working once unenabled native access is blocked. Same for maven's encoding warnings (project.build.sourceEncoding=UTF-8) and the bogus <archive> block on maven-compiler-plugin in ixdar-app/pom.xml, which the plugin has no such parameter for and warned about on every build.
VERIFIED after rescope. mvn -q clean compile: zero lines of output, exit 0. A second no-op mvn -q compile: zero lines, exit 0.

VERIFIED: exporters still announce a real change. Blanked ixdar_automation_cli/mesh-node-catalog.json, ran mvn -q compile; it printed exactly one line, Exported mesh node catalog to .../mesh-node-catalog.json, rewrote the file, and git status for that path came back empty, so the 159401-byte committed content was restored byte-for-byte.

VERIFIED: mvn test -Dtest=SurfaceSplineTest (a class this checkout does not have) exits 0 rather than failing, confirming the surefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests pom property. mvn test -Dtest=ManifoldNativesTest ends with Running unit.mesh.ManifoldNativesTest, its per-class tally, Results:, and Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 with no loader chatter and no restricted-method block in between.

VERIFIED: a throwaway test sleeping one hour, run with -Dixdar.test.timeout=20s, failed at 20.07s elapsed and 23s wall with TimeoutException hangsForever() timed out after 20 seconds, exit 1. Probe file deleted afterwards.

VERIFIED: full suite mvn test is Tests run: 208, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, exit 0, with DenseMeshFewSplitsTest deleted. The only remaining non-INFO output is LWJGL's own sun.misc.Unsafe deprecation notice, which is a real upstream warning rather than chatter.

run-scene --profile still routes through the profile_report command (one code path, hotMethods as a list of lines); gen-docs regenerated CLAUDE.md and ixdar_automation_cli/README.md and gen-docs --check reports no drift; the 55 python CLI tests pass.

RegistryProcessor overrides getSupportedSourceVersion() with SourceVersion.latestSupported(); the five RELEASE_21 SupportedSourceVersion annotations on the registry processors are removed, so mvn -q clean compile now prints nothing at all.
